brief: A wooden river boat gliding downstream with you, Dādī, Śuka and the boatman poling it, the spice seller waving from the bank; Dādī writing with a reed pen in her notebook; beside the boat a small pale-blue spirit shaped like a curved boat riding the current.

The round white stone spirit stopping mid-pat with a thoughtful look; the Vetāla raising an eyebrow from his branch; Dādī and Śuka smiling; a faint glowing speech-mark shape in the air around the spirit's words.

The round white stone spirit rolling between three small stones scratched with a mark each, answering the Vetāla's questions; Śuka laughing; Dādī pointing at the three marks; the Vetāla leaning back satisfied.
The Vetāla seated straight on a root with a solemn expression; the paper-fan spirit unfolding his last fold, which carries three lines of writing; Dādī and Śuka listening; firelight.
